lines.text: Many learners say: I will call to you tonight.
Better: I will call you tonight.
Call you! I will call you tomorrow.

data.wrong: I will call to you tonight.

native.tip: ‘너에게 전화할게’의 ‘에게’를 to로 옮기기 쉬워요. call 뒤엔 바로 사람! 이렇게 말해요 👉 “I will call you tonight.”
native.caption: “I will call to you tonight”처럼 말하고 있나요? 😅 call은 ‘~에게 전화하다’라서 to 없이 사람을 바로 써요. 맞는 문장 ✅ “I will call you tonight.” Carlos 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.
native.comment: 정답: “call you”! call 뒤엔 to 없이! 무료 퀴즈로 더 연습해 보세요: {link}

en.tip: Call needs no to before a person. Say “I will call you tonight.”
en.caption: Do you say “I will call to you tonight” in English? 😅 Call takes the person right after it, with no “to”! “I will call you tonight” is right. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
